noProfile.title: This account isn't linked to a doctor profile
noProfile.body: Ask the hospital administrator to link your sign-in to your doctor profile, then sign in again.

status.title: Your status
status.explain: Updating your status changes the waiting times patients see straight away. When you are running late, patients who booked in the app are also notified.
status.updated: Status updated. Patients' waiting times now reflect it.

current.title: Current consultation
current.emptyBody: When you are ready, call the next patient.
current.noteHint: Saved with this visit. The patient can see it in their app.

followUp.title: Schedule a follow-up
followUp.description: Book {{name}} for another visit with you. They will see it in their appointments.

next.title: Next patient
next.busyHint: Finish the current consultation before calling the next patient.
next.nobodyHint: Nobody has checked in yet. Patients appear here once they arrive.
next.expectedLater_one: {{count}} more patient is booked for later today.
next.expectedLater_other: {{count}} more patients are booked for later today.
next.called: {{name}} (token {{token}}) has been called to your room
next.noShowBody: Token {{token}} will leave today's queue. Use this only if the patient did not come when called.

summary.title: Pre-visit summary
summary.aiLabel: AI-generated from patient-reported information and uploaded documents
summary.disclaimer: Not a diagnosis. Check each item against its source.
summary.noneBody: This patient did not use the assistant or upload documents before the visit, for example a walk-in registered at the front desk.
summary.recordsPaused: The medical records agent is paused: uploaded documents are not included.
summary.chiefComplaint: Main complaint, in the patient's own words
summary.noMedicines: No medicines in the uploaded documents
summary.noResults: No test values in the uploaded documents
summary.transcriptBody: The highlighted line is the source of the item you opened.

queue.title: Today's queue
queue.emptyBody: There are no appointments with you today.
queue.emptyWaiting: No one is waiting right now.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Your OPD sessions and bookings, week by week.

leave.title: Leave and blocked time
leave.description: Requests go to the hospital administrator for approval. Patients can't book approved leave or blocked time.
leave.noUpcoming: No upcoming leave or blocked time.
leave.emptyBody: Request leave or block time when you can't see patients.

kindHints.leave: One or more whole days away.
kindHints.block: A few hours on one day, for example a meeting or a procedure.

leave.formDescription: The administrator will review your request. You'll see the decision here.
leave.reasonHint: A short reason for the administrator, for example "Conference in Chennai".

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Patients you have seen. Open a patient to see their visits with you.
patients.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or mobile number
patients.caption: Patients you have seen
patients.emptyBody: Patients appear here after you complete a consultation with them.
patients.noMatchBody: Check the spelling, or search by mobile number.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileHint: Read only. Ask the hospital administrator to change these details.

scribe.intro: The consultation scribe listens and drafts the note and prescription. Nothing is final until you sign.
scribe.ended: Conversation ended: stop to draft the note
scribe.consentNote: Tell the patient the consultation is being transcribed. Audio is not stored.
scribe.restartBody: The drafted note and prescription will be deleted. You can start listening again.

fields.advice: Advice to the patient (one per line)

scribe.assessmentHint: Only what you said. The scribe never adds a diagnosis of its own.
scribe.signBody: The note becomes final and the prescription goes to the patient's care plan.
scribe.signBodyUnreviewed_one: 1 AI-filled item is not reviewed yet; signing confirms it as written. The note becomes final and the prescription goes to the patient's care plan.
scribe.signBodyUnreviewed_other: {{count}} AI-filled items are not reviewed yet; signing confirms them as written. The note becomes final and the prescription goes to the patient's care plan.
scribe.signedWithPlan: Note signed. {{name}}'s care plan has been sent.
scribe.signedAt: Signed at {{time}}. The prescription is in the patient's care plan.

followUps.title: Patient follow-ups
followUps.subtitle: Alerts and questions from the care companion about your patients' care plans.
followUps.pausedBody: Patient follow-ups appear here when it is switched on.
followUps.emptyOpenBody: Urgent alerts and patient questions will appear here.
followUps.question: Question
followUps.replyHint: The patient sees this in their care plan chat.
followUps.banner_one: 1 urgent patient alert: open patient follow-ups
followUps.banner_other: {{count}} urgent patient alerts: open patient follow-ups
